name: Witch & Dragon: Hope of Elements
description:
About This Game

Wield the elements to defeat your enemies.

Gather resources in perilous domains.

Weigh risk and reward, and retreat before it’s too late.

Combine elements and treasures to create unique builds.

Witch & Dragon: Hope of Elements is a roguelike turn-based strategy RPG built around elemental chain reactions.

Play as Elise, a witch who commands all five elements, and journey alongside the young dragon Pipi to the homeland of the True Dragons, where the truth hidden beyond the clouds awaits.

  • Fire, Water, Earth, Wood, and Lightning combine to create a highly flexible elemental interaction system.

  • When any two different elements come into contact, they trigger a wide variety of elemental reactions.

  • Reactions behave differently depending on whether they affect objects or terrain, and different environments can lead to entirely different outcomes.

  • Cast your magic and discover the limitless possibilities of elemental reactions!

  • Every spell you cast can become the starting point of a chain reaction. The energy released by one elemental reaction can trigger others, spreading across the battlefield and setting off massive cascades.

  • Create explosive elemental combos with a single spell and wipe out waves of enemies in one turn!

  • Choose freely between safe exploration and pushing deeper into dangerous territory. Experience the full “explore, fight, retreat” adventure loop as you challenge stronger enemies and claim rarer treasures.

  • Even if an expedition ends in failure—or you choose to retreat on your own—you can still bring back part of the treasure you collected and return to the Origin Ground to recover and prepare for your next run.

  • Set your own pace, choose your own path, and shape your own adventure!

  • After every battle, choose one treasure from a random selection to strengthen your build.

  • Whether you prefer collecting treasures to create powerful long-term meta builds, or starting fresh each run and improvising your strategy on the fly, every playstyle offers its own unique rewards and strategic depth.

  • Freely combine more than 200 treasures with a wide range of effects to create your own signature combat build!

  • Each of the five elemental domains contains dozens of exclusive events. Even if you revisit the same area multiple times, new event content can still appear.

  • As the main story progresses and your choices shape the journey, events will continue to evolve, gradually revealing the ancient secrets hidden within each realm.

  • Every expedition brings you one step closer to the truth!

  • Defeat enemies to collect resources and elemental seeds, then return to the Origin Ground to cultivate them and harvest rare materials.

  • Use the alchemy system to combine materials into powerful potions, unlock new abilities, and craft a variety of useful items. The rarer the materials, the stronger the effects.

  • Every round of cultivation and crafting will help prepare you for the challenges ahead!

The game is currently in active development, and even more content will be added before launch. If Hope of Elements interests you, feel free to join our official community to get the latest updates, share your thoughts, and send feedback directly to the development team.
short_desc: Harness elemental chains to defeat foes, collect treasures, and craft unique builds in high-risk, high-reward adventures. Witch & Dragon: Hope of Elements is a roguelike with elemental gameplay, RPG mechanics, and turn-based tactics. Join Elise and dragon Pipi on their magical journey.
